title: Reentrancy in withdraw(): state updated after external call
why: withdraw() sends ETH before zeroing balances[msg.sender], so a contract caller can re-enter and drain the vault.
poc_sketch: Attacker contract calls withdraw() and re-enters from receive() until the vault is empty.

title: Missing access control on setFeeRecipient
why: setFeeRecipient()에 onlyOwner가 없어 누구나 수수료 수령자를 바꿀 수 있다.

title: Unchecked ERC20 transfer return value
why: Return value ignored; tokens that return false would fail silently.
poc_sketch: Use a token whose transfer returns false.

title: Floating pragma
why: Floating pragma allows compiling with untested compiler versions.

title: Division before multiplication in fee math
why: Rounds fee down to zero for small amounts.
